commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.
90+1' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

87' Urs Fischer prepares a substitution. Sheraldo Becker is replaced by Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jae-Sung Lee walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sota Kawasaki (Mainz).
86' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

85' Daniel Thioune has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Salim Musah (Werder Bremen) replacing Marco Grull.
82' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

69' Substitution. Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) on for Yukinari Sugawara.
68' A corner kick by Mainz is thwarted by the well prepared Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen).
67' Mick Schmetgens (Werder Bremen) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
67' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. Corner kick. Mainz will have an opportunity.
66' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

64' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
63' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
62' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.

61' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
58' A quickly taken corner by Mainz.
57' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
55' Julian Malatini is being substituted because of an injury. Daniel Thioune sends Mick Schmetgens (Werder Bremen) on the pitch.
54' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
52' 0 - 2 Goal! Sheraldo Becker produces a great pass that finds Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.

51' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
50' Mainz enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
49' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
47' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' Daniel Thioune has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) comes on the pitch for Keke Topp.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.

45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The free kick from long range, taken by Werder Bremen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
38' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
36' 62:38 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
34' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle and it's Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
31' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
31' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
31' Werder Bremen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee signals a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
29' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
28' Werder Bremen keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
25' Stefan Posch (Mainz) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.

24' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
23' Now Mainz have a corner.
21' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
21' Werder Bremen will take a corner kick.
19' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

16' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
13' Werder Bremen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' It looks like Stefan Posch (Mainz) saw red with that tackle. Sascha Stegemann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

8' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar! The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
8' The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen will have a chance to score from a corner.

6' 0 - 1 Phillipp Mwene sends a superb cross into the box. Paul Nebel (Mainz) latches on to it and from close range plants a header in off the crossbar, leaving Mio Backhaus beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:1.
3' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Sascha Stegemann no option but to blow his whistle.
2' An accurate cross picks out Stefan Posch (Mainz) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
